invitation_scope_chk.name: invitation_scope_chk
invitation_scope_chk.value:
(
  ("invitation"."role_key" = 'CUSTOMER' AND "invitation"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invitation"."partner_id" IS NULL) OR
  ("invitation"."role_key" = 'PARTNER' AND "invitation"."partner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invitation"."customer_id" IS NULL) OR
  ("invitation"."role_key" NOT IN ('CUSTOMER', 'PARTNER') AND "invitation"."customer_id" IS NULL AND "invitation"."partner_id" IS NULL)
)

user_role_scope_chk.name: user_role_scope_chk
user_role_scope_chk.value:
(
  ("user_role"."role_key" = 'CUSTOMER' AND "user_role"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_role"."partner_id" IS NULL) OR
  ("user_role"."role_key" = 'PARTNER' AND "user_role"."partner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_role"."customer_id" IS NULL) OR
  ("user_role"."role_key" NOT IN ('CUSTOMER', 'PARTNER') AND "user_role"."customer_id" IS NULL AND "user_role"."partner_id" IS NULL)
)

landing_page_publish_chk.name: landing_page_publish_chk
landing_page_publish_chk.value:
"landing_page"."status" = 'DRAFT' OR (
        "landing_page"."content" IS NOT NULL AND "landing_page"."content_reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND
        "landing_page"."content_reviewed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "landing_page"."published_at" IS NOT NULL
      )

service_duration_chk.name: service_duration_chk
service_duration_chk.value:
("service"."base_duration_minutes" IS NULL OR "service"."base_duration_minutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 10080) AND
        ("service"."duration_per_unit_seconds" IS NULL OR "service"."duration_per_unit_seconds" BETWEEN 1 AND 86400) AND
        ("service"."duration_model" <> 'FIXED' OR "service"."base_duration_minutes" IS NOT NULL) AND
        ("service"."duration_model" <> 'PER_UNIT' OR "service"."duration_per_unit_seconds" IS NOT NULL)

service_area_shape_chk.name: service_area_shape_chk
service_area_shape_chk.value:
(
        ("service_area"."kind" = 'CIRCLE' AND "service_area"."center" IS NOT NULL AND "service_area"."radius_m" IS NOT NULL AND "service_area"."boundary" IS NULL) OR
        ("service_area"."kind" = 'POLYGON' AND "service_area"."boundary" IS NOT NULL AND "service_area"."center" IS NULL AND "service_area"."radius_m" IS NULL)
      )

generated.as: CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL THEN ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(longitude::double precision, latitude::double precision), 4326)::geography END

customer_address_dedupe_uq.name: customer_address_dedupe_uq
customer_address_dedupe_uq.where: "customer_address"."archived_at" IS NULL AND "customer_address"."normalized_key" IS NOT NULL

customer_address_coordinate_range_chk.name: customer_address_coordinate_range_chk
customer_address_coordinate_range_chk.value: "customer_address"."latitude" IS NULL OR ("customer_address"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "customer_address"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

customer_address_geocoding_chk.name: customer_address_geocoding_chk
customer_address_geocoding_chk.value: ("customer_address"."geocoding_status" IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'MANUAL')) = ("customer_address"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_address"."geocoded_at" IS NOT NULL)

partner_active_verified_chk.name: partner_active_verified_chk
partner_active_verified_chk.value: "partner"."status" <> 'ACTIVE' OR ("partner"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "partner"."verified_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

property_text_chk.name: property_text_chk
property_text_chk.value: ("property"."service_requirements" IS NULL OR length("property"."service_requirements") <= 2000) AND ("property"."notes" IS NULL OR length("property"."notes") <= 2000)

lead_contact_channel_chk.name: lead_contact_channel_chk
lead_contact_channel_chk.value: "lead_contact"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "lead_contact"."phone" IS NOT NULL

lead_source_enabled_requires_review_chk.name: lead_source_enabled_requires_review_chk

consent_status_dates_chk.name: consent_status_dates_chk
consent_status_dates_chk.value:
("consent"."status" = 'GRANTED' AND "consent"."granted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "consent"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL) OR
          ("consent"."status" = 'WITHDRAWN' AND "consent"."withdrawn_at" IS NOT NULL)

generated.as: CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL THEN ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(longitude::double precision, latitude::double precision), 4326)::geography END

service_request_properties_chk.name: service_request_properties_chk
service_request_properties_chk.value: "service_request"."number_of_properties" IS NULL OR ("service_request"."number_of_properties" BETWEEN 1 AND 100000 AND "service_request"."customer_type" = 'PROPERTY_MANAGEMENT')

quote_sent_chk.name: quote_sent_chk
quote_sent_chk.value: "quote"."status" IN ('DRAFT', 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'CANCELLED') OR ("quote"."valid_until" IS NOT NULL AND "quote"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL)

price_rule_set_activation_chk.name: price_rule_set_activation_chk
price_rule_set_activation_chk.value: "price_rule_set"."status" = 'DRAFT' OR ("price_rule_set"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "price_rule_set"."activated_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

pricing_calculation_amounts_chk.name: pricing_calculation_amounts_chk
pricing_calculation_amounts_chk.value:
"pricing_calculation"."status" <> 'CALCULATED' OR (
        "pricing_calculation"."net_cents" > 0 AND "pricing_calculation"."tax_cents" >= 0 AND "pricing_calculation"."gross_cents" = "pricing_calculation"."net_cents" + "pricing_calculation"."tax_cents" AND
        "pricing_calculation"."tax_rate_basis_points" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "pricing_calculation"."pricing_version" IS NOT NULL AND
        "pricing_calculation"."rule_set_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pricing_calculation"."estimated_labor_minutes" >= 0 AND "pricing_calculation"."direct_costs_cents" >= 0
      )

pricing_calculation_config_required_chk.name: pricing_calculation_config_required_chk
pricing_calculation_config_required_chk.value: "pricing_calculation"."status" <> 'CONFIG_REQUIRED' OR ("pricing_calculation"."net_cents" IS NULL AND "pricing_calculation"."gross_cents" IS NULL)

generated.as: CASE WHEN base_latitude IS NOT NULL AND base_longitude IS NOT NULL THEN ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(base_longitude::double precision, base_latitude::double precision), 4326)::geography END

employee_coordinates_chk.name: employee_coordinates_chk
employee_coordinates_chk.value:
("employee"."base_latitude" IS NULL) = ("employee"."base_longitude" IS NULL) AND
        ("employee"."base_latitude" IS NULL OR ("employee"."base_latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "employee"."base_longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180))

employee_working_window_minutes_chk.name: employee_working_window_minutes_chk
employee_working_window_minutes_chk.value: "employee_working_window"."start_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439 AND "employee_working_window"."end_minute" BETWEEN 1 AND 1440 AND "employee_working_window"."end_minute" > "employee_working_window"."start_minute"

partner_document_verified_chk.name: partner_document_verified_chk
partner_document_verified_chk.value: "partner_document"."status" = 'PENDING' OR ("partner_document"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "partner_document"."verified_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

booking_cancel_chk.name: booking_cancel_chk
booking_cancel_chk.value: ("booking"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("booking"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "booking"."cancellation_reason" IS NOT NULL)

booking_text_chk.name: booking_text_chk
booking_text_chk.value:
("booking"."operational_notes" IS NULL OR length("booking"."operational_notes") <= 2000) AND
        ("booking"."cancellation_reason" IS NULL OR length("booking"."cancellation_reason") <= 1000)

job_assignment_release_chk.name: job_assignment_release_chk
job_assignment_release_chk.value: ("job_assignment"."status" = 'RELEASED') = ("job_assignment"."released_at" IS NOT NULL AND "job_assignment"."released_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "job_assignment"."release_reason" IS NOT NULL)
